newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria to buy back all CA shares.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria to buy back all CA shares.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Viktor Klima said on Friday that Bank Austria would offer to buy out all existing shareholders of Creditanstalt, including owners of the bank's preference stock.
"There is a provision in the contract according to which an offer has to be made for all ordinary and preference shares," Klima told reporters.
It was not immediately clear whether Bank Austria for its own stock only or whether shareholders would be offered a cash alternative.

Bank Austria has offered holders of Creditanstalt's ordinary voting shares to exchange their shares for those of Bank Austria or to receive a cash payment of 722.50 schillings, just above their current market price of 718.
Bank Austria on Sunday was awarded the state's 70 percent voting stake in flagship bank Creditanstalt for 17.2 billion schillings.

Uncertainty over the fate of Creditanstalt's widely owned preference stock has led to a sharp sell-off of the stock since Monday. The shares have plunged almost 15 percent since the start of the week.
